sections_present: miro1 is specifically retained at depolarized mitochondria in pd fibroblasts
pink1/prkn pd fibroblasts retain miro1 even after long-term mitochondrial depolarization
miro1 retention increases with age in healthy people but not pd patients
miro1 retention can be observed in blood cells and human dopaminergic neurons
chemical induction of miro1 degradation in fibroblasts
future perspectives and link to mitochondrial polygenic risk scores
culture of neural precursor cells (npcs) and differentiation to dopaminergic neurons (hdans)
miro1 knockdown in fibroblast cell lines
data analysis, machine learning and statistics
